tasks.label: MHub — Init Database Schema
tasks.command: echo '=== Applying MHUB_ULTIMATE.sql ===' && docker exec -i mhub-postgres-1 psql -U mhub -d mhub < /workspaces/Mhub/server/database/MHUB_ULTIMATE.sql 2>&1 | tail -20 && echo '=== Applying migrations ===' && for f in /workspaces/Mhub/server/database/migrations/*.sql; do echo "Applying $f"; docker exec -i mhub-postgres-1 psql -U mhub -d mhub < "$f" 2>&1 | grep -v 'already exists\|NOTICE' | tail -3; done && echo '=== Restarting server ===' && docker restart mhub-server-1 && sleep 5 && docker logs mhub-server-1 --tail 20

tasks.label: MHub — Status Check
tasks.command: docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}' 2>&1; echo '---SERVER LOGS---'; docker logs mhub-server-1 --tail 40 2>&1; echo '---HEALTH---'; curl -s -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}' http://localhost:5001/api/health 2>&1 || echo 'curl failed'

tasks.label: MHub — Serve APK & Open Ports
tasks.command: echo '=== Making ports public ===' && gh codespace ports visibility 5001:public -c "$CODESPACE_NAME" 2>&1 && echo '✅ Port 5001 public' || echo '⚠️ Port 5001: set manually in PORTS tab' && gh codespace ports visibility 9000:public -c "$CODESPACE_NAME" 2>&1 && echo '✅ Port 9000 public' || echo '⚠️ Port 9000: set manually in PORTS tab' && echo '' && echo '=== Setting up APK server ===' && mkdir -p /tmp/apk-serve && (cp /workspaces/Mhub/android-native/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk /tmp/apk-serve/mhub.apk 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ APK copied' || echo '⚠️ No APK found at build path, checking /tmp...') && ls -lh /tmp/apk-serve/mhub.apk 2>/dev/null && (kill $(lsof -ti:9000) 2>/dev/null; true) && echo '' && echo '=== Starting HTTP server on port 9000 ===' && echo "APK download: https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-9000.app.github.dev/mhub.apk" && echo "API URL: https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-5001.app.github.dev/" && echo '' && cd /tmp/apk-serve && python3 -m http.server 9000
